catalog.summary:
# V6 Catalog And Music Report

- V6 catalog DB: `reports/current_v6_fetch/llll_backup_20260630_152330/catalog/db_android.sqlite3`
- V6 master DB: `reports/current_v6_fetch/llll_backup_20260630_152330/masterdata/android/master.sqlite3`
- frozen catalog DB: `_MASTER_BACKUP/llll_backup_20260620_225016/catalog/db_android.sqlite3`
- V6 bundles: `54507`
- BGM bundles: `878`
- music rows: `236`
- music thumbnail hits: `236/236`
- offline BGM icon hits for `icon_bgm_{0:D3}`: `0/65`
- offline BGM spriteatlas art extracted: `65/65` from inserted bundle `offlinebgm.spriteatlas`
- catalog diff vs frozen: inserted `4`, deleted `0`, changed `39`
- catalog category diff vs frozen: inserted `9`, deleted `0`

## Files

- `bundle_joined.csv`: V6 live catalog bundle table with joined categories
- `bundle_categories.csv`: category counts
- `bgm_bundles.csv`, `sound_bundles.csv`, `image_bundles.csv`: scoped bundle exports
- `musics_full.csv`: full `Musics` rows plus `Subtitle=Description` and derived asset labels/presence
- `offline_bgm_expected_art.csv`: source-derived `icon_bgm_{0:D3}` lookup result for every offline BGM
- `catalog_diff_vs_frozen.csv`: schema-aware live catalog diff by `(label, ext)`
- `catalog_category_diff_vs_frozen.csv`: category membership diff by `(label, ext, category)`
- `frozen_catalog_schema.csv`, `v6_catalog_schema.csv`: catalog DB schema comparison inputs
